The main choices break down pretty simply:

• Blumat Classic: best for a few individual houseplants. Each stake pulls water from its own nearby container.
• Blumat Classic XL: the same idea, but better for larger pots or thirstier plants.
• Blumat Vacation Kit: best when you have lots of houseplants and want them all drawing from one shared reservoir.
• Blumat Starter Kits: best if you want to learn the full blumat system for a small group of plants. They use a raised reservoir, supply tubing, and soil-moisture sensors to water automatically.

If you want the easiest starting point for a few plants, go with Blumat Classic. If you want one reservoir feeding several plants, go with the Vacation Kit or a Starter Kit depending on how many plants you want to cover.
